name: K'ap Shap
description: K'ap Shap is a two-player draw-and-discard game played with Chinese dominoes. The aim is to complete a hand with one identical pair (ngán) and three pairs of tiles whose spots add up to 10 or 20 (counting the 4-2 tile as 3 spots). It is a variant of K'ap Tái Shap, documented by Culin (1895) as played in Chinese gambling houses in the USA.

rules.objective: Complete a winning hand: one identical pair (ngán) and three pairs of tiles whose spots add up to 10 or 20 (counting the 4-2 tile as 3 spots).
rules.gameplay:
1. Setup: Build wall 4 high by 8 wide; first player takes 8 tiles, second takes 7.
2. Turn: Optionally take a face-up discard (if it completes your hand you win); then draw one tile from the wall. If the drawn tile completes your hand you win; otherwise discard one tile face up.
3. Winning: First to announce a complete hand collects the pot.
keyRules: Winning hand has one identical pair (ngán) plus three pairs totaling 10 or 20 pips
The 4-2 tile counts as three spots, not six
You may take one discard and draw one from the wall each turn
